meta.title: Multiline literal types in CRLF ending files are not normalized to LF
meta.build_notes: npm pyright@1.1.391 (2024-12-18) and pyright@1.1.392 (2025-01-15); release window from the maintainer's comment.
meta.notes: R5 (LF to CRLF is semantics-preserving: the runtime reads 'a\nb' either way, as the issue and the maintainer confirm).

settings_note: The issue names no settings (command line and Pylance defaults); the session defaults (basic type checking) apply; reportAssignmentType is on in basic mode.

files.note: stored with LF line endings; the probe makes the CRLF copy

repro.steps: The same file once with LF and once with CRLF line endings, each opened in a fresh session. Reported: with CRLF, pyright reports that Literal['a\r\nb'] is not assignable to the declared Literal['a\nb'] (reportAssignmentType); with LF there is no error, and the line ending should not matter. Probe (R5): the diagnostics and the hover on a of the CRLF copy must equal those of the LF original.
